title: Several processes share one database folder safely
description:
As a user running the app, a server and a CLI on one library at once, I want writes from any process to be safe and visible to the others.

```gherkin
Feature: Multi-process safety
  Scenario: Concurrent writers lose nothing
    Given a database folder with table "events"
    When 2 processes each put 500 distinct records into "events" at the same time
    Then "events" contains 1000 records

  Scenario: Only one conditional create wins
    Given a database folder with table "locks"
    When 2 processes each create record "L1" only if it doesn't exist
    Then exactly one succeeds and the other gets an error of kind "ConditionalCheckFailed"

  Scenario: A reader sees another process's write without a full reload
    Given a reader and a writer process on the same folder
    When the writer puts record "x1"
    Then the reader's next get of "x1" returns it
```
